name: comp-457

frames.best_why: Shows the whole card and the centred page counter between both chevrons, cursor away.

tagline: A centred page counter flanked by two chevrons in a card footer.
summary: A small pagination footer that states the current page and total between left and right chevron links, with no numbered pages.
appearance: A dark rounded card carries four hairline-split invoice rows; beneath them a centred line reads Page 3 of 10 with the numbers brighter, flanked by small left and right chevrons.
behaviour: Hovering a chevron shifts it a touch and the links point to the previous or next page. The caption is fed by currentPage and totalPages while the rows hold still.
demo_content: Invoice rows INV-2031 to INV-2034 for Acme, Globex, Initech and Umbrella; Page 3 of 10.
search_phrases: simple pagination with current page text
go forward or back one page
move through a list page by page
use_when: A compact list or table footer where a full numbered pager would be too heavy.
avoid_when: When people need to skip several pages: the control only steps one page at a time.
customise: currentPage and totalPages drive the caption and the disabled ends; chevron size, spacing and link styling are fixed in the classes.
weight_why: Two chevron links and a short caption; no loop or heavy script.

a11y.note: Each chevron has an aria-label and the counter is a live region; the hover shift has no reduced-motion guard.

polish_why: Compact centred counter with clear chevrons; tidy but unremarkable.
title: Compact Page Pagination
